$comment: Maintenance tickets covering all five lifecycle states (Open, InProgress, Pending, Resolved, Closed) for the Nordvik NV1 demo. SLA hours follow the Lua tickets.check_sla defaults (Critical 2h, High 4h, Medium 8h, Low 24h); the loader writes metadata.slaHours / metadata.slaDueAt. 'tags' always include the floor-plan handle (e.g. L02-OP060) so the plant-map HUD can correlate tickets to stations. '$fromTelemetry' blocks are expanded by the loader from telemetry.json.

maintenance_tickets.title: Laser power drift - weld penetration below spec on rotor seam
maintenance_tickets.description: Laser power at the workpiece dropped from 6.0 kW to below the 5.7 kW alarm limit. Seam camera reports penetration depth 1.9 mm (spec >= 2.1 mm) on 3 consecutive rotors. Cleaning the protective glass only recovered power briefly - suspect contaminated collimator optics.
maintenance_tickets.escalation_reason: SLA breached (Critical, 2 h) and root cause not found after glass cleaning - requesting engineering support for optics inspection

change_history.note: Picked up via station QR code

maintenance_tickets.title: Replace protective glass D37 on rotor laser cell - waiting for parts
maintenance_tickets.description: Glass shows burn-in spots after cleaning. Replacement required, but only 2 pcs left in store and both are reserved for the weekly PM on NV-L1-OP060.
maintenance_tickets.pending_details: Ordered 20 pcs from Lumora Photonics Direct (Demo), PO-DEMO-4471, ETA 2 days. Stock 2 / minimum 10.

maintenance_tickets.title: Trickle resin flow rate below 12 ml/min
maintenance_tickets.description: Flow meter on the A-component reports 11.6 ml/min for 10 minutes (nominal 14 ml/min). Possible partially clogged static mixer nozzle.

maintenance_tickets.title: Spindle bearing noise on housing CNC - OEM service visit booked
maintenance_tickets.description: Vibration envelope rising for 2 weeks (2.1 -> 3.4 mm/s), audible bearing noise at 12000 rpm. Spindle at 1460 h of the 1500 h service interval. Bearing set out of stock; OEM brings it with the service visit.
maintenance_tickets.pending_details: Spindelwerk OEM technician booked for Thursday (service order SO-DEMO-118). Machine runs at reduced spindle speed until then.

maintenance_tickets.title: Bearing press-fit force curve outside envelope (2 of last 500)
maintenance_tickets.description: Two NOK press-fit curves on roundtable station 2: peak force 31.8 kN vs window 33-35 kN. Parts quarantined automatically.

maintenance_tickets.title: End-shield screw torque deviation on spindle 3
maintenance_tickets.description: Spindle 3 reaches 8.1 Nm instead of 8.5 Nm target (tolerance 5%) on every 20th cycle. Checking bit wear and transducer calibration.

maintenance_tickets.title: Magnet bonding adhesive lot change - process parameter update required
maintenance_tickets.description: New adhesive lot has higher viscosity. Dispense pressure must be raised by 0.3 bar; process engineering action required before restart of lot 24-118.
maintenance_tickets.pending_details: Waiting for process engineer to release the updated dispense recipe (pressure +0.3 bar).

maintenance_tickets.title: Final vision gate recipe change - awaiting quality sign-off
maintenance_tickets.description: New housing variant B needs an extra ROI for the DataMatrix code. Recipe validated on 50 golden parts; quality sign-off pending.
maintenance_tickets.pending_details: Validation report attached in MES; waiting for quality engineer signature.

maintenance_tickets.title: Ring light intensity degraded on stator vision station
maintenance_tickets.description: Auto-exposure compensates +18% exposure time; no false rejects yet. Plan LED ring replacement at next PM.

maintenance_tickets.title: Fume extraction filter differential pressure warning
maintenance_tickets.description: Filter dP reached 1.8 kPa (warning 1.6 kPa). Filter cartridge replaced.

maintenance_tickets.title: Leak test false rejects after seal kit change
maintenance_tickets.description: False reject rate 3.2% after fixture seal change. Root cause: new seal seated 0.2 mm proud. Fixture re-shimmed, golden-part check OK.

maintenance_tickets.title: Scheduled protective glass replacement (400 h interval)
maintenance_tickets.description: Planned replacement of the D37 protective glass and power-meter check (6.02 kW at workpiece).

maintenance_tickets.title: Robot collision during gripper change on hairpin insertion cell
maintenance_tickets.description: Robot hit the gripper rack during tool change after a manual teach correction. Gripper finger bent, collision detection stopped the robot. Rack position re-taught and verified.
maintenance_tickets.escalation_reason: Automatic Trigger: Robot collision detected on cell

maintenance_tickets.title: EOL test bench annual torque sensor calibration
maintenance_tickets.description: Scheduled calibration of the dyno torque flange. Certificate stored in the calibration system.

ticket_comments.author: Lua: Laser Power Drift Watchdog
ticket_comments.content: Auto-created: laser_power_kw 5.68 kW < 5.70 kW alarm limit (5-sample moving average 5.74 kW).

ticket_comments.author: Ada Ampere (Demo)
ticket_comments.content: Restarted at reduced speed. Power dropping again (5.75 kW after 40 min). Glass temperature rising faster than normal - suspect collimator.

ticket_comments.author: Hugo Hertz (Demo)
ticket_comments.content: SLA breached. Escalated to Iris (parallel work). Ada keeps the line running at reduced speed; spare collimator lens (1 pc) reserved.

ticket_comments.author: Kurt Kelvin (Demo)
ticket_comments.content: PO-DEMO-4471 approved. Raised minimum stock for D37 glass to 10 pcs for the laser fleet.

ticket_comments.author: Nils Newton (Demo)
ticket_comments.content: Reduced max spindle speed to 10000 rpm. Vibration stable at 3.3-3.4 mm/s.

ticket_comments.author: Kurt Kelvin (Demo)
ticket_comments.content: OEM confirmed Thursday, bearing set ships with the technician.

ticket_comments.author: Mia Mohs (Demo)
ticket_comments.content: Both NOK rotors are in the red quarantine box at OP040.

ticket_comments.author: Vera Volt (Demo)
ticket_comments.content: Gripper finger replaced from stock, rack position P12 re-taught, 20 dry cycles OK.

ticket_comments.author: Iris Joule (Demo)
ticket_comments.content: Root cause: teach correction saved to the wrong tool frame. Added a frame check to the teach checklist. Closing escalation.
